thrace.definition: n. an ancient country and wine producing region in the east of the Balkan Peninsula to the north of the Aegean Sea; colonized by ancient Greeks; later a Roman province; now divided between Bulgaria and Greece and Turkey
thrace.translation: n. 色雷斯(巴尔干古国)

thracian.definition:
n. an inhabitant of ancient Thrace
n. a Thraco-Phrygian language spoken by the ancient people of Thrace but extinct by the early Middle Ages
a. of or relating to Thrace or its people or culture
thracian.translation:
n. 色雷斯人(语)
a. 色雷斯的

thracians.definition:
plural of Thracian
n. an inhabitant of ancient Thrace
n. a Thraco-Phrygian language spoken by the ancient people of Thrace but extinct by the early Middle Ages
a. of or relating to Thrace or its people or culture
thracians.translation:
(Thracian 的复数) n.色雷斯人(语)
a. 色雷斯的

thraldom.definition: n the state of being under the control of another person
thraldom.translation:
n. 奴隶的身分/地位, 奴役, 束缚
[法] 奴隶身份或地位, 奴役

thrall.translation: n. 奴隶, 束缚, 奴役

thralldom.definition: n the state of being under the control of another person

thralls.translation: n. <文>奴隶( thrall的名词复数 ); 奴役; 奴隶制; 奴隶般受支配的人

thrapple.translation: n. <苏格兰>(尤指马的)咽喉, 气管

thrash.definition:
n. a swimming kick used while treading water
v. give a thrashing to; beat hard
v. beat so fast that (the heart's) output starts dropping until (it) does not manage to pump out blood at all
v. move data into and out of core rather than performing useful computation
thrash.translation:
vt. 打, 使逆行, 胜过, 推敲, 鞭打
vi. 打谷, 痛打, 剧烈扭动, 逆行
n. 打谷, (划水)鞭状动作

thrash sth out.translation: 研讨解决, 研讨决定, 通过讨论获得

thrashed.translation: v. 鞭打以示惩罚( thrash的过去式和过去分词 ); 战胜, 完全击败; 乱窜[跳], 辗转反侧; 打谷, 打麦

thrasher.definition: n. thrush-like American songbird able to mimic other birdsongs
thrasher.translation: n. 打谷机, 脱粒机

thrashers.definition:
plural of thrasher
n. thrush-like American songbird able to mimic other birdsongs
thrashers.translation: (thrasher 的复数) n. 打谷机, 脱粒机

thrashes.definition:
n a swimming kick used while treading water
v give a thrashing to; beat hard
v move or stir about violently
v dance the slam dance
v beat so fast that (the heart's) output starts dropping until (it) does not manage to pump out blood at all
v move data into and out of core rather than performing useful computation
v beat the seeds out of a grain
v beat thoroughly and conclusively in a competition or fight
thrashes.translation: v. 鞭打以示惩罚( thrash的第三人称单数 ); 战胜, 完全击败; 乱窜[跳], 辗转反侧; 打谷, 打麦

thrashing.translation:
n. 鞭打, 打谷
[计] 系统颠簸, 抖动

thrashings.definition:
plural of thrashing
n. a sound defeat
thrashings.translation:
(thrashing 的复数) n. 鞭打, 打谷
[计] 系统颠簸, 抖动

thrasonical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Thraso; like, or becoming to,
   Thraso; bragging; boastful; vainglorious.
thrasonical.translation: a. 自夸的, 夸口的, 吹牛的

thrasybulus.translation: n. 特扰叙布洛斯（古雅典爱国者、将军）

thraupidae.translation: [网络] 裸鼻雀科；唐纳雀科

thrave.definition:
n. Twenty-four (in some places, twelve) sheaves of wheat; a
   shock, or stook.
n. The number of two dozen; also, an indefinite number; a
   bunch; a company; a throng.

thraw.translation: 不一致, 不符合,使扭曲, 盘绕

thrawart.translation: a. [苏格兰英语]；犟的；爱抬杠的, 爱闹别扭的

thrawn.translation: 扭弯的, 畸形的, 丑陋的
